report:
Reviewed the complete associated_identity claim: each trait/impl function, type, and constant has its own stable owner-associated symbol; repeated requests and movement among siblings retain both identity and owner. Independently verified exact byte equality of all four implementation files and the test file against the supplied historical input; the historical rationale remains applicable after reassessing the current claim, all four ordinary implementation entries, and both ordinary test bodies.

Source evidence: associated.rs keys individual tracked trait/impl queries by owning symbol and LocalAssociatedItemKey(kind, name, occurrence), rather than sibling position. Membership enumeration and semantic lowering share those queries. lower_item creates each of the three symbol kinds with Some(owner). consts.rs, fns.rs, and type_aliases.rs keep name/scope/owner in identity and CST/span in tracked detail fields, so sibling placement changes do not remint the symbol. Each owner has its own query namespace, preserving distinct item ownership.

The complete moving_associated_items_preserves_symbol_query_keys test exercises all six owner/kind combinations, both inserted siblings and reordered siblings, forward and reverse. Its visible owner assertions reject lost association; its query-log assertions reject changed identity through an interned ObservedSymbol and tracked observer. Captured helper and database logging fragments establish that the observer keys on the actual symbol and WillExecute events are recorded and drained. The complete trait_items_have_stable_symbols_and_owner_identity test checks function/type/constant trait ownership and equality of semantic and membership symbol lists, exercising repeated requests through both entry points. Its receiver/generic assertions cover additional anchors and are not substituted for identity assertions. These integration assertions plus the keying implementation adequately account for all aspects; no TODO or N/A entries or deferred prerequisites exist.

Captured extra context: fixture/root setup and identity observer in test-harness lib.rs, database query logging in db.rs, and review rules. Validation here was source inspection and exact baseline comparison; personally executed review start/read/record commands, not behavior tests or a workspace build. The coordinator separately reports 321 sage-meta tests and a root cargo build passing; that is baseline execution, not execution by this reviewer. No source changes or requested edits.
